_doc: Per-task fields added to a frozen instance.json when it is copied into scripts/robodojo/frozen/ (sync_frozen.py). physics: PhysX settings on top of RoboDojo's (recorded and used by every session, the service and the grader). determinism: 'state' (default: the grader's two fresh-process replays must end in the same state hash) or 'verdict' (both replays must succeed; their end states may differ), with the reason.

make_toast.physics_why: without PhysX enhanced determinism, 1 of 3 fresh processes reset to a different state; with it, all agree (scripts/robodojo determinism test)

make_toast_random.determinism_why: its resets are not always bit-identical across fresh processes, even with PhysX enhanced determinism (the 15 clutter objects); the grader requires both replays to succeed

pour_liquid_into_cup.determinism_why: the liquid is simulated as GPU PhysX particles, which are not bit-reproducible across processes (also with enhanced determinism); the grader requires both replays to succeed

pour_liquid_into_cup_random.determinism_why: the liquid is simulated as GPU PhysX particles, which are not bit-reproducible across processes (also with enhanced determinism); the grader requires both replays to succeed

pour_by_language.determinism_why: the liquid is simulated as GPU PhysX particles, which are not bit-reproducible across processes (also with enhanced determinism); the grader requires both replays to succeed

fold_clothes.determinism_why: the garment is simulated as GPU PhysX cloth, which is not bit-reproducible across processes once the arms handle it (a live episode and its two fresh-process replays, all started from the exact frozen state, ended in three different states, measured 2026-10-10); the grader requires both replays to succeed
change_log: 2026-10-10: determinism class `state` -> `verdict` (`instance.json`: `"determinism": "verdict"`; the scene, the layout, the recorded reset hash and RoboDojo's success check are unchanged). The task could not be passed before: every trial that folded the garment was scored 0 as "not deterministic", because GPU PhysX cloth does not replay bit for bit (the determinism test that classed it `state` moved the arms without handling the cloth). Both replays must succeed now; `state_identical` is still reported. Standard mode: the service resumes `approx`. Trials graded before this date with `deterministic` 0 are re-scored from their recorded fields (`all_success` / `replay_success`), not rerun.
